summary: End-to-end UI test of Fase 1 Laba Rugi (Supplier CRUD, Purchases create + receive + draft delete, weighted-average HPP verification on Products, Expenses regression with new enum). All 8 feature flows PASS. Weighted-average HPP math verified correct on Products page: ZZ UI PO Test now shows Stok=30 and Harga Modal=Rp 1.333 after receiving a 10 qty @ Rp 2.000 purchase on top of initial 20 qty @ Rp 1.000 ((20*1000+10*2000)/30 = 1333). Nav items (nav-suppliers, nav-purchases) are rendered; purchase total displays Rp 20.000; price input auto-formats to 'Rp 2.000'; receive flow transitions status Draft -> Diterima and hides receive/delete buttons; draft delete works; expense category enum lists exactly the 8 required values (Sewa, Gaji, Listrik, Air, Internet, Bahan Baku, Transport, Lainnya).

minor.issue: When the supplier is referenced by purchases (FK), the API still returns success (204 from PostgREST with 0 rows affected) and the UI shows a 'Dihapus' success toast, but the row stays. Should return 409/400 with 'Supplier masih digunakan pada pembelian' or check affected rows and raise HTTPException.

action_items: (Optional) Harden DELETE /api/suppliers to detect FK/no-op deletes (use Prefer: return=representation or count=exact) and return a proper 409 with Indonesian message so the UI shows an error toast when the supplier has related purchases.

Main agent to clean up leftovers (per the request): received purchase 'INV-UI-1-85742' for product 'ZZ UI PO Test', the throwaway product itself, and the orphan supplier 'CV Maju Jaya' (id 6784bd3b-f68e-4cfc-9d85-d7dffc4d5b8c) — UI delete is currently blocked by FK silently.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/suppliers in server.py does not verify any rows were actually removed by PostgREST — add a count check or Prefer: count=exact and raise 409 when 0 rows deleted so UI reflects reality.

Bookkeeping expense row uses data-testid=expense-row-${r.key} (prefixed 'e-') while the delete button uses expense-delete-${r.id} (raw uuid) — inconsistent naming makes test automation harder. Consider aligning both to the raw id (expense-row-${r.id}).

rca of the issue: Only minor issue: UI toast 'Dihapus' is shown for supplier delete even when the DB did not actually remove the row (FK with purchases). RCA: backend DELETE /api/suppliers forwards to PostgREST and accepts 204 as success without inspecting the number of rows affected. Mitigation: switch to Prefer: return=representation (or Prefer: count=exact) and raise HTTPException(409, 'Supplier masih dipakai di pembelian') when the response contains an empty array / zero count. Alternatively tighten the FK to ON DELETE RESTRICT so PostgREST returns an error.
